text:
mina: quick async q — where do I grab logs / metrics / traces for the acme-corp Private VPC? I'm repro-ing a prom remote_write failure and want dashboards, sample traces, and any otlp/log forward examples :wave:
josh: For metrics start with the Grafana tenant dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/xyZAcme/acme-corp-overview. Look for metrics with labels cluster=acme-prod and tenant_id=acme-corp. Key metrics: `remote_write_queue_length`, `remote_write_failures`, `scrape_duration_seconds` :eyes:
kyle: logs are forwarded via promtail -> otlp. Example promtail client snippet we use for customer tenants: ```clients:
  - url: "http://otlp-ingest.internal:4318/v1/logs"
  - url: "https://otlp.redwood.com:4318/v1/logs" # fallback
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: kubernetes-pods
    pipeline_stages: []```
oncall-sre: traces can be sparse if sampling is low — tenant config often sets `trace_sampling_rate` to 0.05 for high-card customers. Check Jaeger/trace-search for the tenant: https://traces.redwood.com/search?tenant=acme-corp. If you need a quick span to look at, search for `http.request` + `status>=500`.
mina: got it. the customer reported a big batch of remote_write errors overnight — do we want to relax the alert or tune thresholds before we dig in?
josh: I'd prefer to tune alerts after we see sample logs. For now, adjust alert to fire on `remote_write_failures > 10` for 10m for acme-corp, but open an OBS-ops ticket so we can revert if it's masking real issues. ping @sre-lead to pick this up.
sre-lead: I can take it. @mina can you paste 3-5 raw log lines showing the remote_write error (include headers/status). If they show 401/403 treat as creds; 5xx likely ingestion/network. Also include the pod name + image so we can correlate.
mina: sample log pasted below (stripped PII): ```2026-03-16T03:22:11Z promtail[acme-promtail] ERROR remote_write: send failed status=502 host=otlp-ingest.internal:4318 body="bad gateway"```

josh: 502 means upstream transient. Could be intermittent network or an ingress proxy. Check `upstream_proxy_5xx_count` on the Grafana panel. If it's sustained, we should open a capacity incident with infra.
infra-bot: promtail-config rollout for tenant acme-corp completed (sha=a1b2c3). Config uploaded to s3://redwood-configs/acme-corp/promtail.yaml :white_check_mark:
mina: thanks — next steps for me: open OBS-ops ticket with log snippet, link to dashboard, and request alert tune; tag @sre-lead. I'll include timestamps and the pod names.
josh: also add the promtail pod logs link: `kubectl -n acme-system logs -l app=promtail --since=12h` and paste the output in the ticket.
sre-lead: happy to help with alert thresholds after we see the ticket. if the customer needs temporary relief we can mute the alert for 2 hours while we investigate.
mina: will do. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
